responsibility: Defines the i386 DJGPP target configuration for 32-bit MS-DOS. This header sets the object-format and assembler directives, builtin predefines, startup and library specs, named-section hook, weak and BSS emission rules, ABI type sizes, debugger register mapping, PIC rejection policy, COFF/LTO hooks, and other OS-specific target macros that adapt the generic i386 backend to the DJGPP runtime and toolchain.
same_name_distinction: Unlike djgpp.cc, which implements a few helper hooks, and djgpp.opt, which only declares an option, this header is the main DJGPP target configuration surface, defining the DOS/COFF macros, specs, ABI properties, and binding the DJGPP hooks into the backend.
